title: Submittals.
officialText: Submittals required by TMS 602/ACI 530.1/ASCE 6 Section 1.5 shall be sent to the applicant of record for review prior to use of the materials or methods of construction. In addition the contractor shall submit a Material Storage and Protection Plan.
